notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Morphling.
Morphling does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, creating three 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate an Elemental token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
